items.caption:
How well do you know yourself when it comes to the small things that bring you joy?👀✨

Today’s conversation on Tokimeki is with my husband Takumi💛
For us, this question is a simple question that we keep asking ourselves and each other over and over, even in the smallest moments!✨

For me, tea of all kinds spark so much joy!🍵
I love learning about things like:
- Who made this tea?
- Where did these tea leaves come from?
- What’s the story behind it?
I make sure to incorporate tea into my daily routine as an added Tokimeki moment of my day, so I can reset and slow down no matter how busy I am💛 It’s self-care for me!

For my husband Takumi, it’s learning about the stories and people behind food production or the food industry. Seeing how their dedication and stories play a part in the things that they produce and create.

We both truly believe that when you start choosing to do things that contribute to your own Tokimeki, that this positive energy that you carry will be shared with others around you and in the end, create a happier world, one person at a time.

Tokimeki isn’t a destination. It’s a sensitivity you get to keep sharpening and honing though repeated rituals of truly noticing what makes you feel alive, even in the smallest moments. From there you can take small actions towards your best and happiest life.

Start with the joy-sparking cup you use in the morning, the thing on your desk that makes you smile, and it opens into something bigger, something more meaningful in your life.

When Tokimeki sparks in you, it doesn’t just stay with you.
It reaches the people beside you, and beyond.

Explore Tokimeki with us, together as a community!

Come join us @artoftokimeki not only to stay curious about the things that truly spark joy for you, but to hone your sense of Tokimeki in a community that cheers each other on and share that Tokimeki with others!

Take the first step with us:
1) Follow us @artoftokimeki!
2) Share your Tokimeki: Let us know below: What has been sparking joy for you recently?👇

items.transcript: マリーさんが最近ときめいていることは何ですか?やっぱりね、お茶です。お茶って今までももちろん好きっていうふうに思っていたし、最近ストーンに、より一層お茶ってときめくなって思うようになっていて、飲むお茶の茶葉がどこで作られた、何、どこさんの茶葉なのかとか、その器、作家さんが誰で、今日はどういう組み合わせにしようとか、考える一つ一つがもうときめいてときめいて、だからやっぱりときめくもの、小さいものこそときめきで丁寧に選んでいくことって本当に大切なんだなって思います。たましさん最近何かときめきますか?一次産業とか職に携わっている人にときめいてます。だからこそすごくそこにこだわりを持ってやっている人たちの尊さだったりとか、なぜこれをやっているのかっていう話を聞かせてもらったときに、やっぱすごく美しいなって思う。でもやっぱそこに背景にどんな人がいてどんなストーリーがあるかを知ると、やっぱ喜びときめき増えるんだよね。だからやっぱりより豊かによりときめきで生きていこうと思うときの一つのキーワードって繋がりな気がしていて。つまり一人一人が自分のときめきに向き合って、お互いのときめきも応援したりしながら繋がり合っていく世界を作っていくこと。自分自身ではときめくことをしている、楽しんでしていることが結果として世の中のエネルギー自体をいい状態で保っていって、実はすごい活動だったりするんですね。

items.caption:
The KonMari Method is so much more flexible than what many people think, and that’s the beauty of it! Our lives change with each season of life we are in, and that means that the things we own have already served their purpose can then be let go with gratitude to make space for what’s new✨I am so honored that the KonMari Method has touched the lives of people all over the world, and that so many people still love and follow the Method after all these years, and I hope that everyone has given themselves permission to let their joy change with each season of life they are in.❤️

After becoming a mother of three wonderful children, I’ve noticed how much joy I get when I spend quality time with them, and that sometimes, not having a perfectly organized home at all times doesn’t align with my current ideal life. That being said, tidying does spark joy for me, so it truly brings me joy when I tidy the home together with my family✨

I would love to hear your life-changing stories below if you don’t mind sharing!❤️My heart always warms up whenever I hear about your tidying journeys!

#sparkjoy #konmari #organization #organizationinspo #tidying

Today’s the day to answer our Tokimeki Question! This week’s is especially exciting because the question asks us: What is a special skill you gained through your work OR a special skill you have that supports your work? It’s basically like sharing your secret superpower!👀✨

For Marie, her special skill is the ability to look at a drawer and know exactly what size box would fit perfectly into it to organize, and also her ability to know how to best utilize that drawer!

Share below:
📌”What’s one skill you’re proud you built through your work or that supports your work?

We’d love to know what each of your Tokimeki work superpowers you have!👇

#artoftokimeki #tokimeki #sparkjoy #skill #career
items.transcript: What one skill you are proud you built through your work? For me, it's from my work in organizing. I can look at a drawer and just know what size box will fit perfectly inside. I can also look at a box and know exactly which drawer it belongs in. It's a rare skill, but it helps me at work and at home. I'm very proud of this skill. Think about your own skill, one that came from your work, if you'd like. Share it with us.
